description: This file defines classes and functions for handling WebSocket extensions, including compression and multiplexing extensions, with implementations for deflate, permessage-deflate, permessage-compress, and mux extensions. It manages extension negotiation, stream options setup, and compression ratio logging.

classes.name: ExtensionProcessorInterface
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket extension processors, providing interface methods for extension negotiation, response generation, and stream setup.

classes.name: _AverageRatioCalculator
classes.description: Utility class for calculating average compression ratios based on total bytes processed.

classes.name: DeflateFrameExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Processor for deflate-frame extension, handling compression/decompression of frames with window size and context takeover options.

classes.name: PerMessageDeflateExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Processor for permessage-deflate extension, managing per-message compression with window size and context options.

classes.name: _PerMessageDeflateFramer
classes.description: Helper class for framing messages with per-message deflate compression, including stream options setup.

classes.name: CompressionExtensionProcessorBase
classes.description: Base class for perframe and permessage compression extension processors, handling common logic.

classes.name: PerMessageCompressExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Processor for permessage-compress extension, utilizing deflate-based compression.

classes.name: MuxExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Processor for WebSocket multiplexing extension, managing extension activation and quota.

methods.name: get_extension_processor
methods.description: Creates and returns an extension processor instance based on the extension offer received.

methods.name: is_compression_extension
methods.description: Checks if a given extension name is a supported compression extension.
